name: murlan-loop
description: The ticket loop: supervisor, gate, picker and the workspace tools they run. A separate product from the game in the same repository, with its own suite, so a change to a card animation does not wait on worktree pruning and a change here does not run the game every time. This file carries no scripts and no dependencies on purpose: the suite is `npm run loop:test` from the repo root, because these tests read the repository itself — ci.yml, the protocol files, the worktree registrations — and every one of them would be looking in the wrong place with the cwd npm sets here. What it is for is `type: "module"`, which is what stops Node reparsing land.ts and ciVerdict.ts on every supervisor start, and marking where the loop ends and the game begins.
